session.title: Session 8 - Personal Feelings, Opinions & Experiences (Adj)
session.classInfo: CCBE Galle Branch • TUE/THU/IPET015 • Ms. Sumodya Sewmini (Lecturer in Charge)

words.m: Shows, films, music, or performances that give people pleasure and enjoyment.
words.s: There is plenty of live entertainment in the city centre every weekend.

words.m: Television, radio, newspapers, and the internet as ways of sharing news and information.
words.s: The event was widely reported across social media and television.

words.m: Exciting physical events in a story, film, or play.
words.s: My brother loves watching exciting action films at the cinema.

words.m: A woman who performs a character on stage, on television, or in films.
words.s: The young actress won an award for her performance in the play.

words.m: The money that you pay to enter a museum, concert, or theatre.
words.s: Museum admission is free for school students on Fridays.

words.m: An unusual, exciting, and sometimes daring experience or journey.
words.s: The children read an exciting adventure story about exploring an island.

words.m: A notice, picture, or short film telling people about a product, job, or service.
words.s: We saw an advertisement for the summer music festival in the newspaper.

words.m: The group of people gathered together in one place to watch or listen to a play, film, or concert.
words.s: The audience clapped loudly at the end of the concert.

words.m: A new book or other product that has bought by a very large number of people.
words.s: Her latest detective novel quickly became an international bestseller.

words.m: An animated film or a humorous drawing in a newspaper or magazine.
words.s: My little sister watches her favourite cartoon every Saturday morning.

words.m: A famous person, especially in entertainment, television, or sport.
words.s: A well-known television celebrity opened the new school library.

words.m: A television station and the programmes that it broadcasts.
words.s: Which television channel is showing the wildlife documentary tonight?

words.m: A travelling show with acrobats, clowns, and performers, usually held in a large tent.
words.s: The circus will be performing in our town next week.

words.m: Serious traditional music written by composers such as Mozart and Beethoven.
words.s: Listening to classical music helps me concentrate while studying.

words.m: A play, film, or television programme that is intended to make people laugh.
words.s: We watched a very funny British comedy at the theatre last night.

words.m: An organized event in which people try to win a prize by being the best.
words.s: She entered the school singing competition and won first prize.

words.m: A live performance of music by one or more musicians or singers.
words.s: We bought tickets for the Friday evening orchestra concert.

words.m: A party or club where people dance to recorded pop music.
words.s: The school organized a disco in the main hall at the end of term.

words.m: A public arrangement of things or a show for people to look at and enjoy.
words.s: Everyone gathered in the park to watch the colourful gymnastics display.

words.m: A film or television programme that gives real facts about a subject.
words.s: We watched an interesting documentary about ocean wildlife.

words.m: A picture made with a pencil, pen, or crayon rather than paint.
words.s: She showed the art teacher a detailed pencil drawing of the old station.

words.m: A public display of paintings, photographs, or other objects of interest.
words.s: Our class visited a photography exhibition at the national gallery.

words.m: A special day or period with public concerts, plays, and celebrations.
words.s: Thousands of visitors came to the annual summer music festival.

words.m: A person who directs or produces films for the cinema or television.
words.s: The young film maker won a prize for his short documentary.

words.m: Small containers that explode with bright colours and loud noises in the night sky.
words.s: Bright fireworks lit up the harbour at midnight.

words.m: Traditional music from a particular country or region passed down through generations.
words.s: The band played traditional Sri Lankan and British folk music.

words.m: A musician who plays the guitar.
words.s: The lead guitarist played a wonderful solo during the concert.

words.m: A pair of small speakers worn over the ears to listen to audio privately.
words.s: Please wear your headphones during the dictation practice session.

words.m: A person who is admired for doing something very brave or good, or the main male character in a story.
words.s: The brave firefighter was praised as a local hero.

words.m: A woman who is admired for bravery, or the main female character in a book or film.
words.s: The heroine of the novel solved the mystery with courage and intelligence.
